'''Sy''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith officer|Logistics Officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he was stationed on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], selling specialty goods.

==Behind the scenes==
Sy was removed from the game in update 6.2 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''.<ref name="Patch notes">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1292020/game-update-6.2|text=Game Update 6.2}}</ref>
